## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff is within the stated scope.
- [ ] No secret, credential, private key, contact submission, or PII is included.
- [ ] New dependencies and actions are policy-approved and immutably pinned.
- [ ] Security, accessibility, responsive, and documentation impacts were considered.
- [ ] Production deployment remains a separate, explicitly approved action.
